title: The cornea bends incoming light
summary: The cornea, the clear front of the eye, is dome-shaped and bends light to help the eye focus.
body: The National Eye Institute describes the cornea as the clear front layer of the eye. It is shaped like a dome, and it bends light so the eye can focus. Light goes on through the pupil after that bend. The page was updated on 20 April 2022 and is a United States institute description of a healthy eye, not an exam of one person.

sources.title: How the Eyes Work
sources.author: National Eye Institute
sources.note: Supports the cornea as the clear, dome-shaped front layer that bends light to help the eye focus.
